【文件夹监控任务】检查 ~/Downloads 目录中近1小时内新增的文件：
```python
import os, time
from pathlib import Path
watch_dir = Path.home() / 'Downloads'
ignore_exts = {'.crdownload', '.part', '.tmp', '.DS_Store'}
now = time.time()
new_files = []
for f in watch_dir.iterdir():
    if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() not in ignore_exts and not f.name.startswith('.'):
        if now - f.stat().st_mtime < 3600:  # 1小时内修改
            new_files.append(f)
print(f'发现 {len(new_files)} 个新文件: {[f.name for f in new_files]}')
```
